name: slopbot-forwarder
description: SlopBot AI thin forwarder — keeps the Twitch links alive, captures chat/events/redemptions, forwards them batched (OIDC) to the ELM's ingestion endpoint, serves the OIDC-verified relay webserver the ELM connects to, lingers after stream end, exits 0. No engine — that's ELM-side.

scripts.lint: node --check bin/forwarder.js && node --check lib/config.js && node --check lib/irc.js && node --check lib/eventsub.js && node --check lib/relay.js && node --check lib/forwarder.js && node --check test/helpers.js && node --check test/irc.test.js && node --check test/forwarder.e2e.test.js
